Caller action: each silence adds 1 in code; the first ones repeat the short question, the n-th ends the call with the fixed sentence. The counter restarts with each new question (the files do not say per question or per call).
Agent action: every calming reply is spoken only through the counting gate; once n are used the gate routes to the agent transfer.
The tool result shows a send (exitState DONE); the hook counts it and the first transition ends at the main menu at n. The brain also refuses a further send once the counter is at n.

The tool result shows a change; the hook counts it and the node is left at once. The brain keeps the changed card and answers a further request with the yearly sentence. No service tells whether the right was used before this call, so earlier changes cannot be counted.
The tool exists only in the confirm node; the first successful result fires the limit transition before the model can call it again.
The names are counted inside one sentence, so a step counter cannot hold it: the code takes at most n names from the caller's own card list and the sentence is spoken as fixed text.
Agent action: a fresh offer is spoken only through the counting gate (counter reset by code at each reading); a second pass goes to the main menu.

where: brain (after_cards, after_bal, after_email, after_week, after_dec; counter re_<service>)
why: n is per service call: the hook marks an HTTP 401, the brain sends the call to the same service node again at most n times and treats any further failure as a service failure. The two writing tools are not retried (side effect).
